english.title: Export dutiable / restricted goods on hovercraft not approved by Commissioners
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) exported

(A)_[dutiable]_
(B)_[restricted]_

goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), in a hovercraft

(C)_[which was not of a class or description approved by the Commissioners]_
(D)_[other than in accordance with a condition imposed by the Commissioners, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONDITION..)]_
(E)_[other than in accordance with a restriction imposed by the Commissioners, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RESTRICTION..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 60(4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

english.notes: Section 60(3) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that any goods shipped or entered contrary to section 60(1) or 60(2) above shall be liable to forfeiture.
